title: Mashed Potatoes
description: This mod adds mashed potatoes. Simple
body:
**Mashed Potatoes**
============
This mod adds mashed potatoes to the game.

Recipe 1:

- 1 Baked potato

  ![Recipe1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18f49b5d8c0c64194dcb8c0954d1bac646912cfb.png)

- Gives 2.5 Hunger bars
- Gives 0.3 Saturation

Recipe 2:

- 1 Mashed potato
- 1 Steak
  ![Steak](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e22657b0e01224027bfd6ecfe1550cb7a115eef.png)

- Gives 10 Hunger bars
- Gives 200 Saturation
